guard/31347.htm.text: Guard Burke: You picked a bad time to visit Rune, my friend. People like you may help ease my workload, but... Oh, well... Come closer... links.text: "A plot? What are you talking about?"
"Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
